description: Verification-only provider. OpenStreetMap is used solely as a cross-reference source for verifying data collected from other providers, not as a primary data source.
notes: Purpose: Verification-only reference source. OpenStreetMap is not intended to be a primary collector in this registry; it exists to cross-check and validate data gathered from official providers. Intended use: Manual/automated verification cross-reference only. Future configuration: If verification tooling requires it, endpoint or query details must be added manually during Stage 3B.2. Manual certification required: This provider must be manually reviewed before any verification workflow depends on it. No URLs, endpoints, or dataset IDs have been invented or pre-filled.
